p: godly man ceaseth: Who dare defend the truth and show mercy to the oppressed.
flattering lips and with a double: He means the flatters of the court which hurt him more with their tongues than with their weapons.
With our tongue will we prevail: They think themselves able to persuade whatever they take in hand.
For the oppression of the poor: The Lord is moved with the complaints of his, and delivers in the end from all danger.
set him in safety from him: Because the Lord's word and promise is true and unchangeable he will perform it and preserve the poor from this wicked generation.
them: That is, yours though was only one man.
when the vilest men are exalted: For they suppress the godly and maintain the wicked.
